Help choosing the number of clusters

Source: R/cluster_functions.R
eemsom_kselect.Rd

The units of a self-organising map are clustered with different numbers of clusters k. Several criteria are calculated for each k.

Usage

eemsom_kselect(som, k = 2:9, method = "complete", seed = NULL)

Arguments

som

object of class eemsom, see eemsom

k

numeric vector of numbers of clusters to be tested

method

clustering method, see eemsom_cluster

seed

seed for the random number generator, only used for method = "kmeans". With NULL (default), the current random number stream of the session is used, so set.seed before the call gives reproducible results. With a number, the seed is set for this calculation only and the random number state of the session is restored afterwards.

Value

data frame with one row per k

Details

  • silhouette: mean silhouette width of the units (Rousseeuw 1987), higher is better

  • negative: number of units with negative silhouette width, i.e. units that are closer to another cluster, lower is better (Ejarque-Gonzalez and Butturini 2014)

  • davies_bouldin: Davies-Bouldin index, lower is better (Inf if two clusters have identical centres)

  • wss: within-cluster sum of squares, look for an elbow

References

Rousseeuw, P. J. (1987). Silhouettes: A graphical aid to the interpretation and validation of cluster analysis. Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics 20, 53-65. doi:10.1016/0377-0427(87)90125-7

Davies, D. L., Bouldin, D. W. (1979). A Cluster Separation Measure. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 1(2), 224-227. doi:10.1109/TPAMI.1979.4766909

Ejarque-Gonzalez, E., Butturini, A. (2014). Self-Organising Maps and Correlation Analysis as a Tool to Explore Patterns in Excitation-Emission Matrix Data Sets and to Discriminate Dissolved Organic Matter Fluorescence Components. PLoS ONE 9(6), e99618. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0099618

See also

Other clustering: eemsom_cluster(), eemsom_plot_silhouette(), eemsom_split()

Examples

data(eem_list)

som <- eemsom(eem_list, rlen = 100, seed = 42)
eemsom_kselect(som, k = 2:6)
#>   k silhouette negative davies_bouldin       wss
#> 1 2  0.5203208        0      0.6639666 8333.2481
#> 2 3  0.5702871        0      0.5061423 2676.1187
#> 3 4  0.5125841        0      0.3559383 1863.7990
#> 4 5  0.3985742        0      0.5463554 1220.6489
#> 5 6  0.4120996        0      0.4334395  863.8047
